observations: Industrial sewing machine on a white table with red trim.
Brand 'Emel' is visible on the front of the machine head and the metal frame.
The machine has a foot pedal and a motor mounted on the frame.
A spool stand and a bobbin winder are attached to the table.
The table surface shows some wear and a red marking on the right edge.
The background wall shows significant peeling paint and cracks.

claims.evidence: Photos show surface wear but cannot confirm mechanical condition.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and the needle bar moving.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal mechanical issues or excessive noise.
risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: The table surface may be damaged or uneven.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the entire table surface.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and sewing.
Close-up photos of the table surface to check for damage.
Photo of the machine head with the needle down to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
